daily_quests.title: ASX 200 Price Momentum with Window Functions
daily_quests.description: Using the ASX 200 historical prices dataset, write a query that calculates a 30-day rolling average price and identifies the top 10 stocks by price momentum (current price vs 30-day average). Use window functions (AVG() OVER) and CTEs to structure your solution. Your output should include: stock_symbol, current_price, rolling_avg_30d, momentum_percentage, and rank_by_momentum. Filter for stocks with at least 30 trading days of data in the last quarter.

daily_quests.title: NSW Road Crash Data Cleaning & Aggregation
daily_quests.description: Download the NSW Road Crash Data from data.nsw.gov.au. Write a Python script using pandas to: (1) load the CSV, (2) handle missing values in crash severity and location columns, (3) standardise datetime formats, (4) remove duplicates based on crash ID, (5) categorise crashes by severity level and suburb, (6) export a cleaned dataset and a summary report showing crash counts by severity and top 10 crash hotspots. Your script should be production-ready with error handling and logging.

daily_quests.title: AIHW Health Expenditure Trend Analysis Pipeline
daily_quests.description: Build a data engineering pipeline combining Python and SQL: (1) Use Python/pandas to download and clean AIHW health expenditure data (government, private, and out-of-pocket spending by state and year), handling missing values and standardising column names, (2) load the cleaned data into a SQLite database, (3) write a SQL query using CTEs and window functions to calculate year-on-year spending growth rates by state and expenditure category, identify states with highest growth, and rank categories by total expenditure, (4) export results to CSV. Document your data quality checks and transformation logic in comments.
